description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ability Berserk] and [Explosive Fury Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Ability Berserk
description.text: Forces a random available action excluding Defend, affects targeting (single: random enemy/ally; group: all enemies/allies if the action's auto-target group is enemies/allies), Berserk, Confuse, Paralyze, Stop are prioritized

description.name: Explosive Fury Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, Ice attacks deal 30% more damage, casts Beat Down after using five Ice abilities

description.name: Beat Down
description.text: One group attack (7.40) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, removes [Explosive Fury Mode] from the user
